semanticReview.finding: No flatwasher/Washer component, model alias, or Footprinter3d case exists; source search 'washer' returns only splitwasher models and mention of washer faces in other fasteners.
semanticReview.distinction: Flat washer is the fundamental unbroken, planar load-spreading family. Split/key washers have different retention features. Flat gasket shares annular geometry but has a separate sealing purpose.

semanticReview.finding: No family, alias, historical PR topic, or source-index match.
semanticReview.distinction: Open C-section ring with plier lugs, not a washer.

semanticReview.finding: No rigid pipe/fitting PRs; the excluded straight flexible hose has the same simple annular primitive.
semanticReview.distinction: Generic rigid fluid transport family; geometry reuse is explicit, no new size counted as a model.
Solid plain round raw stock, without hollow bore, keyway, hex section or threads.
Mounting bracket specific to cylinder end envelope and machine base, not motor bolt-pattern bracket. Choose one mounting construction, not multiple count variants.
Industrial panel-mounted operator includes barrel and locknut/bezel; existing root components are PCB-contact push buttons.
Wiring duct has repeating finger slots in both sidewalls and removable snap-on lid, not an open structural channel.
Housing plus rolling bearing and external mounting bores; not flanged plain sleeve.
Static support clamp and mounting pedestal, not a moving linear bearing or shaft locating collar.
Elastomer spider and meshing jaws; each chosen coupling has a different fundamental compliance construction.
Conical pitch envelope for intersecting axes; nominal teeth visualization only.
